title: Nike Moon Shoe: a 1972 pair (one of 12 made by Nike co-founder Bill Bowerman for the 1972 Olympic trials, the only known unworn pair) sold for $437,500 at Sotheby's New York on 23 July 2019, a sneaker auction record at the time (Al Jazeera, UPI); its remake, the Nike Moon Shoe OG Black/Sail IX3952-001, is in stock in India at ₹8,995 (Superkicks UK 6-12, VegNonVeg lists UK 7-11; checked 11 Nov 2026); Nike US price $105
